items.rationale: Cabinet glass is a glazing element. It is excluded from accidental damage under 2.6.4, and the optional glazing peril 2.1(e) is not shown as agreed (3.5(a)), matching reference Case 3.
Preparatory glazing work under 1.3, excluded by 3.5(b) because the glazing peril was not agreed (Case 3: t=0).

items.description: Installation of new glass into frame
items.rationale: Setting and fitting the glass is glazing work, excluded by 3.5(b) and 7.1.11 (Case 3: t=0).
Removing and disposing of the broken element is glazing work (3.5(b)). Debris removal does not extend to items whose damage is not covered (5.2.1).

items.description: Repair of dented solid-wood side table
items.rationale: Sudden accidental damage (2.6.1) to household furniture is covered as necessary repair cost under 7.1.1(b). The price is set at a fair market level similar to the Case 3 timber repairs; no deductible is stated.

items.description: Touch-up of pre-existing scratches on second cabinet
items.rationale: Pre-existing condition on an unaffected item is excluded by 3.6(a)/(b), 7.1.5 and 7.1.9.
One attendance per undertaking is payable in full where indemnified work was carried out (7.1.12). Here the covered table repair was done; price level follows Case 3 (below 28).
A return visit is not separately indemnified without the insurer's prior agreement (7.1.12).
General administrative flat rates are not repair costs under 7.1.8(b).
